output.answer_markdown: APA's fiscal 2022 risk factors identify a U.K. tax change and a U.S. tax change. In the U.K., the Energy Profits Levy was announced on May 26, 2022 as an additional levy at a 25 percent rate [1]. On November 17, 2022, the U.K. announced an increase in the levy to a 35 percent rate, effective January 1, 2023 [2]. The risk factors say this U.K. tax could adversely affect the Company's future financial condition and cash flows [3]. In the U.S., the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 introduced a new 15% corporate alternative minimum tax [4]. It applies to corporations whose average annual adjusted financial statement income exceeds $1.0 billion for any three consecutive tax years [5], and any resulting liability could adversely affect the Company's future financial results [6].
